title: Flight YYZ → BUD (Air Canada AC1810)
notes: Overnight flight. Sleep on the plane.

title: Hotel Rum Budapest (4 nights)
notes: Two adjoining doubles on the 5th floor. Roof bar opens at 17:00.

title: Casual first dinner — Belvárosi Disznótoros
notes: No reservations — order at the counter. Try the szürkemarha sausage.

title: Breakfast at Centrál Café
notes: Get the eggs Benedict.

title: Parliament tour (English, 11:00)
notes: Tickets are per-person; bring passports. Photo ID required at entry.

title: Walk: Chain Bridge → Buda Castle (funicular)
notes: Funicular is touristy but worth it. Skip if the queue is >30 min and walk up.

title: Fisherman's Bastion + Matthias Church
notes: Upper terraces are paid; lower terraces are free and give the same view.

title: Dinner — Hungarian goulash (TBD)
notes: Anna to pick a spot — Leo allergic to paprika? confirm.

title: Széchenyi Thermal Bath (morning)
notes: Bring flip-flops. Rent towel on-site (700 HUF).

title: Heroes' Square + walk through City Park
notes: Right next to Széchenyi; do these together.

title: Szimpla Kert ruin bar (evening)
notes: Iconic. Gets packed after 22:30.

title: HÉV suburban train: Batthyány tér → Szentendre
notes: Buy ticket at the machine; tap & ride.

title: Wander Szentendre Old Town + Marzipan Museum
notes: Lunch at a Danube-side terrace.

title: Farewell-to-Budapest dinner
notes: Pick something near the hotel — early train tomorrow.

title: EuroCity train EC 273 'Metropolitan': Budapest Keleti → Praha hl.n.
notes: Reserved 4 seats together. Dining car is decent enough.

title: Hotel U Prince (3 nights)
notes: Right on Old Town Square. Rooftop terrace — go up for sunset.

title: First Prague dinner — Lokál Dlouhááá
notes: Classic Pilsner Urquell tankovna. No reservations.

title: Old Town Square & Astronomical Clock (top of hour)
notes: Be in the square 5 min before the hour.

title: Walk Charles Bridge → Malá Strana
notes: Get there before the crowds (yes ha).

title: Prague Castle complex (timed entry 14:00)
notes: Circuit B covers St. Vitus, Old Royal Palace, Basilica, Golden Lane.

title: Dinner at U Medvídků (own brewery)
notes: Try the X-Beer 33 if anyone's brave.

title: Jewish Quarter walking circuit (Josefov)
notes: Combined ticket covers 4 synagogues + cemetery. Closed Saturdays.

title: Lennon Wall & Kampa Island
notes: Quick photo stop on the way to Petřín.

title: Funicular up Petřín + Lookout Tower
notes: Use Prague transit pass on the funicular.

title: Pick a dinner spot for tonight
notes: Open question. Maya wants Vietnamese James votes for another beer hall. Decide by morning of.

title: Train Praha hl.n. → Kutná Hora hl.n.
notes: Buy tickets at the machine. Return train at 16:38.

title: Sedlec Ossuary + St. Barbara's Church
notes: Bone church and the cathedral. Lunch in between.

title: Jazz Dock evening set (20:30)
notes: Tickets are reserved seats — pick them up at door.

title: Flight PRG → SPU (Smartwings QS 1131)
address: Cesta dr. Franje Tuđmana 1270, 21217 Kaštel Štafilić
notes: Carry-on only, no checked bags booked.

title: Apartment Riva Split (2 nights)
notes: Self check-in via keypad. Hostess sends code morning of.

title: Dinner: Konoba Matejuška (seafood)
notes: Tiny — go right at opening or book ahead.

title: Diocletian's Palace self-guided walk
notes: Cathedral bell tower climb worth it for the view.

title: Bačvice beach afternoon
notes: Sandy beach (rare in Croatia). Locals play picigin in the shallows.

title: Marjan Hill hike + sunset
notes: Bring water. Trail starts behind Varoš district.

title: Catamaran Split → Hvar (Krilo Jet)
notes: Foot-passenger only. Be at the dock 30 min before.

title: Villa Skansi Hvar (2 nights)
notes: 10 min uphill walk from port. Has a small pool.

title: Sunset dinner: Dalmatino Hvar
notes: Reservation under 'Chen'. Beef cheek is the standout.

title: Pakleni Islands boat day (Carpe Diem Beach)
notes: Water taxis leave from Hvar Riva all morning. ~5 min ride to Jerolim, longer to Palmižana.

title: Hike up to Fortica (Spanish Fortress) for sunset
notes: 20 minute uphill walk. Iconic view over Pakleni at sunset.

title: Ferry Hvar → Split (early)
notes: Walk-on. Coffee on board.

title: Flight SPU → YYZ (return, multi-leg)
address: Cesta dr. Franje Tuđmana 1270, 21217 Kaštel Štafilić
notes: SPU→FRA→YYZ. Cost is in the day-1 outbound booking.
